findings.summary: refreshBufferSeconds set to 6000 instead of 600, making the refresh window 100 minutes instead of the intended 10 minutes before expiry.
findings.mechanism: The task brief and the stale comment both specify a 600-second (10-minute) buffer before the 24h token expires. The new value 6000 is a 10x overshoot — tokens will be refreshed 100 minutes before expiry, not 10, which is a materially different (and unintended) refresh window.
